entries.title: Psalms 108:1
segments: <<A Song, A Psalm of David.>> My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.

entries.title: Psalms 108:2
segments: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will  awake right early.

entries.title: Psalms 108:3
segments: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 108:4
segments: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth [reacheth] unto the skies.

entries.title: Psalms 108:5
segments: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 108:6
segments: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer  us.

entries.title: Psalms 108:7
segments: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

entries.title: Psalms 108:8
segments: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my  sceptre.

entries.title: Psalms 108:9
segments: Moab is my washpot;  Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.

entries.title: Psalms 108:10
segments: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who  hath led me unto Edom?

entries.title: Psalms 108:11
segments: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

entries.title: Psalms 108:12
segments: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

entries.title: Psalms 108:13
segments: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
